Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
1. Ground-targeted heals (Asylum, Liturgy of the Bell) are placed the moment you press them, no targeting circle: on your hard target if it is a party member, otherwise on you.
2. Esuna now cleanses tanks first, then healers, then DPS. New "DPS" target choice for any Route stack.
3. Config → Overlay has "Reset current job (<job>)" and "Reset all jobs" in place of one button per job.
4. WHM spends lilies on Afflatus Rapture on both buttons from level 76 (Afflatus Solace below).
5. WHM always refreshes Dia/Aero while moving; the "refresh DoT while moving" knob is gone.
6. Tiles put each modifier (weave, moving, …) on its own line, and names wrap more naturally: "Presence / of Mind", while short names like "Thin Air" or "Summon Egi" stay on one line. The Timeline setting is now just "Name wrap".
7. Multi-step actions show the step they lead to: SGE's Eukrasian Dyskrasia tile now has its own icon.
8. Knob values are kept per job: setting Lucid Dreaming MP on WHM no longer changes SGE or SMN. Values saved by an older build are copied to every job that has the knob on first load.

Minor: Rescue no longer shows a "no default" warning; cleanse cards are labelled "cleansing stack"; shorter plugin description, "by hiarc", one command per line in the help; below level 30 the Eukrasian Dosis tile uses its own icon.

Notes for testers: if you saved a custom rule order for WHM's Holy button, press "Reset current job (WHM)" once so the new moving order applies. Going back to a build older than this one drops per-job knob values (they reset to defaults there).
